text: 杰西处置 Emilio 尸体的时候，浴缸被酸液腐蚀穿洞，天花板直接溶解，和 Emilio 混合物一起掉下来，视觉冲击简直无敌了😂
textEn: When Jesse tries to dispose of Emilio's body, the acid eats through the bathtub. The ceiling dissolves, and the remains of Emilio come crashing down with it. The visual impact is absolutely unmatched 😂

images.alt: 杰西戴着防毒面具向浴缸倒入酸液
